name: Neural Plasma Field Ray Casting with LUT Emissivity
definition: A rendering method that shoots rays through an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB), queries a neural network for density and temperature, and uses a Look-Up Table (LUT) to compute emissivity for Line-of-Sight (LOS) integration.
summary: Neural Plasma Field Ray Casting with LUT Emissivity synthesizes coronal images by mapping neural density and temperature predictions to physical emissivity via a precomputed look-up table, distinguishing itself from fixed analytic models.
